en.headline: Huanggang Port records 79500 passenger trips on first day of operations
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said immigration clearance and public transport connections ran smoothly, meeting official expectations ahead of the holiday weekend.
body: The redeveloped Huanggang Port handled 79,500 passenger trips and 8,000 vehicle movements on its first full day of operations on Monday, according to figures from the Shenzhen General Station of Exit and Entry Frontier Inspection.

Of the passenger movements, 41,300 entered Hong Kong while 38,200 departed. The numbers count crossings rather than unique travellers. Transport Secretary Mable Chan told a radio programme on Tuesday that the overall operation of immigration clearance and public transport connections was smooth and met the government’s expectations.

Chan said operators were preparing additional staff and services for higher passenger and vehicle flows expected during the coming Chung Yeung holiday weekend. The 24-hour checkpoint opened at 6.30am on Monday under a joint clearance model.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸首日錄得7.95萬人次及8000車輛架次出入境
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，出入境及公共交通接駁整體順暢，符合預期，當局正為重陽節長周末增加人手及服務作準備。
body: 重建後的皇崗口岸周一正式運作首日，錄得7.95萬人次及8000車輛架次出入境，數字來自深圳邊檢總站。
旅客中，4.13萬人次進入香港，3.82萬人次離開。數字計算的是出入境人次而非個別旅客。運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周二接受電台訪問時表示，出入境通關及公共交通接駁整體運作順暢，符合政府預期。
陳美寶說，預料重陽節長周末人流及車流會更高，營運商正增派人手及加強服務。新口岸於周一早上6時半啟用，採合作查驗、一次放行模式，24小時運作。
